{{Navbar-GOGPT-tracker}}
'''Gulf NPM power station''' is an operating power station of at least 135-megawatts (MW) in Hemaraj SIL - Nong Khae District, Saraburi, Thailand.

==Background==

The project began selling electricity to the Electricity Generating Authority of Thailand (EGAT) on March 1, 2019 under the Small Power Producer (SPP) program.
